I have added the new PHP sample dlp/src/deidentify_cloud_storage.php demonstrating how to submit and monitor a Cloud Storage de-identification job using Google Cloud DLP API.

Summary of Implementation
Public API: Implemented deidentify_cloud_storage() within the Google\Cloud\Samples\Dlp namespace.
Configurations:
Configures input Cloud Storage bucket path using CloudStorageOptions & FileSet.
Configures inspect config for PERSON_NAME and EMAIL_ADDRESS infoTypes.
Configures output Cloud Storage bucket path and de-identification templates for general, structured, and image files.
Configures BigQuery dataset and table to store transformation details.
Job Submission & Polling: Submits the DLP inspection job and polls until completion.
Findings Summary: Prints the job name, final status, and finding counts for each discovered infoType.
